Name: T's Spouse Room
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][size=4]A farmhouse map was created for multiple spouses!
If you are concerned about your spouse's area extending horizontally, please use this one![/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18917][size=6]T's Apartment House[/size][/url][/quote]

A few tweaks are made so as not to ruin the vanilla atmosphere.
The center room will be slightly larger due to the addition of a hallway.
Some of the spouses' rooms have objects in their way when entering from the lower side, so those were also moved.
The spouse's room will only become a private room after the house has been upgraded twice!
﻿
It is unlikely to be compatible with other mods that edit the Farmhouse map.
This is a recommended mod for those who want vanilla map + α.
[size=3][color=#ffff00]Version 2.2~[/color]
Added compatibility with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17526]Lnh's First FarmHouse[/url]﻿".[/size]

If the custom NPC is the spouse, he/she may not be able to enter the room due to furniture placement.
Please make a compatibility request for this as well.
We will probably be able to accommodate this soon!

[color=#ffff00][size=5]Notes on using CSR/PSR.[/size][/color]
As stated in the in-game ModConfig, currently CSR-related settings will not be displayed correctly if you change them while loading.
More details below.
[quote][size=3]Currently, due to the CSR/PSR side, if you change this item while the game is loaded, the display will not be displayed correctly. If you change it in the title and then load it, it will display correctly, so please change the settings in the title. Even if you change the settings while it is loaded and the display is buggy, it will be displayed normally if you return to the title and reload it. (Please try relogging several times as it may not be fixed at once.)[/size][/quote]
